errors.name: MissingFileError
errors.description: Raised when the input CSV file path does not exist or cannot be accessed.

errors.name: MalformedCSVError
errors.description: Raised when the CSV file contains malformed data, such as incorrect delimiter usage or invalid row structure that prevents successful parsing.

errors.name: ColumnLookupError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to access a column header that is missing from the CSV header row during parsing.
